tasks.description: Add a 'Forgot password?' link on the login page that opens a form for users to request a password reset. This link should be accessible and visible to users who need to reset their passwords.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user is on the login page, when they click the 'Forgot password?' link, then a form to enter their email address appears.

tasks.summary: Add email form for password reset
tasks.description: Create a form where users can enter their email address to request a password reset. This form should validate the email address and ensure it matches an existing account.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user enters their email address in the password reset form, when they submit the form, then a reset token is generated and an email is sent to the user's registered email address.

tasks.description: On request, generate a single-use, time-limited reset token. This token should be unique and expire after a specified time window.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user requests a password reset, when a reset token is generated, then the token is unique and has a limited lifespan.

tasks.description: Email a reset link containing the generated token to the user's registered email address. This link should be accessible and allow the user to reset their password.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user requests a password reset, when an email with a reset link is sent, then the link contains a valid reset token and directs the user to the password reset form.

tasks.description: Provide a reset form where users can enter and confirm a new password. This form should validate the token and ensure the new password meets the required criteria.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user clicks the reset link, when they enter and confirm a new password, then the token is validated and the new password is accepted if it meets the required criteria.

tasks.description: On successful reset, hash and store the new password using the existing password-hashing scheme. This should ensure the user's new password is secure and protected.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user successfully resets their password, when the new password is stored, then it is hashed and protected according to the existing password-hashing scheme.

tasks.description: After a successful reset, invalidate the user's existing sessions to prevent account takeover. This should ensure that previously issued tokens can no longer be used.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user successfully resets their password, when their existing sessions are invalidated, then previously issued tokens can no longer be used to access the user's account.
